text:
ITEM 1 | Bright green leafy greens, large flat broad leaves with visible veins, mostly whole with some folded; scattered thin orange shreds (julienned carrot) mixed among them; covers roughly the left third to left-center of the plate, about 15 cm across, piled moderately high (about 3 cm), slightly glossy and fresh-looking | 120
ITEM 2 | Thin green beans, trimmed, lying in a loose cluster across the lower-center of the plate, about 12 cm long each, bright green, firm, with some pale stem ends; footprint roughly 10 by 6 cm, about 1 cm high | 70
ITEM 3 | Single small cherry-sized red tomato half-hidden under the greens near the bottom center, glossy skin, about 2 cm across | 10
ITEM 4 | Browned cooked meat pieces, irregular chunks and slices about 2 to 4 cm, with dark caramelized edges, matte to slightly glossy surface, firm and sliced, sitting on the upper-right portion of the plate, footprint roughly 12 by 9 cm, about 2 cm thick | 130
ITEM 5 | Cooked white rice grains, somewhat clumped and moist-looking, with small flecks of green herb mixed in, sitting between the meat and the greens in the right-center of the plate, footprint about 6 by 6 cm, about 1.5 cm high | 80
ITEM 6 | Small loose orange carrot shreds scattered over the greens and rice, thin matchstick strips about 3 to 5 cm long, bright orange, slightly moist | 8
ITEM 7 | Small pale green herb leaves and a few sprigs mixed through the rice and at the right edge of the meat, bright green, thin and delicate | 4
